chunks: To which you pay no heed.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'To which you pay no heed'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Saad, this phrase underscores the disbelievers' deliberate rejection of the Quranic message despite its clarity, reflecting a state of spiritual arrogance. Shia exegesis often links this heedlessness to the failure to recognize the divine authority of the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing it as a precursor to the final judgment where their excuses will be deemed invalid.
